description: This file implements the functionality of a wait queue for event-driven programming, including initialization, updating, pushing, popping, removing, and batch processing of wait queue elements, utilizing an event timer system.

classes.name: liWaitQueue
classes.description: Structure representing a wait queue with associated timer and synchronization data.

classes.name: liWaitQueueElem
classes.description: Element within the wait queue, containing timestamps and linkage for queue management.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_init(liWaitQueue * queue,liEventLoop * loop,const char * waitqueue_name,liWaitQueueCB callback,gdouble delay,gpointer data)
methods.description: Initializes a wait queue with a specified event loop, callback, delay, and data.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_stop(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Stops the wait queue's timer and halts its operation.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_set_delay(liWaitQueue * queue,gdouble delay)
methods.description: Sets the delay for the wait queue and updates the timer accordingly.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_update(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Updates the timer based on the head element's timestamp and current time.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_push(liWaitQueue * queue,liWaitQueueElem * elem)
methods.description: Adds an element to the wait queue, maintaining order and updating the timer.

methods.name: liWaitQueueElem * li_waitqueue_pop(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Removes and returns the oldest element if its timestamp indicates it is ready.

methods.name: liWaitQueueElem * li_waitqueue_pop_force(liWaitQueue * queue)
methods.description: Removes and returns the oldest element regardless of its timestamp.

methods.name: void li_waitqueue_remove(liWaitQueue * queue,liWaitQueueElem * elem)
methods.description: Removes a specific element from the queue, updating pointers and timer as needed.

methods.name: guint li_waitqueue_pop_ready(liWaitQueue * queue,liWaitQueueElem ** head)
methods.description: Processes and removes all ready elements, returning the count and updating the head.

ctags.name: li_waitqueue_init
ctags.signature: (liWaitQueue * queue,liEventLoop * loop,const char * waitqueue_name,liWaitQueueCB callback,gdouble delay,gpointer data)
